color-no-hex.message: Raw hex is not allowed. Use a --forge-* token (see src/webview/src/styles/forge-tokens.css).

color-named.message: Named CSS colours are not allowed. Use a --forge-* token.

overrides.comment: Generated Pajamas primitives: the one file where raw colour may live.
The semantic layer maps primitives and host colours onto meaning, so it alone may name them.
Forge Desktop's token layer (body.forge-desktop only): the two design references' palette, named once and used through --fd-* tokens; spec in forge-desktop docs/DESIGN.md.
